cross_table_checks: Verified principal identity references current profile/workspace through a read-only resolver, no polymorphic FK fiction
Subscription commit rechecks account customer, approved price revision/entitlement_enabled, application active and authority fence in one transaction
Complete task has exactly one immutable completion audit and projection result; deferrable constraint trigger verifies at transaction end
Immutable evidence/key/identity fields and all audit rows reject UPDATE/DELETE; table owner is not used by application sessions
Task operation reference and authority account/domain match at claim/commit/renew/release
At most one in-flight/ambiguous operation for account/kind; provider intent replay deadline never refreshed by retry
Finance revisions, stale source dates, exact allocation/invoice/current registry anchors and ownership are checked within commit, not merely by caller
Operations unique success audit includes task kind/identity; no second receipt or hidden routing lifecycle

Every audit source_id is deterministic stage + operation/task + claim_generation where appropriate; completion uses task:completed exactly once. Claims/defer/wake audits never share completion outcome identity.

Claim requires completed current seed manifest at authority key (scope,migration,shadow_dataset); source snapshot generation and code/catalog checkpoint match comparison. No runner consumes partially backfilled data.
logical_refinements: Physical Phase 2 authority modes/engine are constrained to shadow_only/shadow. Live legacy/simplified transition requires separately reviewed later barrier migration; handover entry point is blocked in Phase 2.
operations.operation_kind adds backfill/shadow_comparison; both are isolated audit/run types, not user business commands.
All retained current Finance FKs are explicit, even where the logical schema summary omitted them.

json_contracts.evidence: Versioned bounded discriminated record for source/task kind. Required correlation/scope/event time, verified subject references and approved fixed fields copied from current minimal-evidence contract. No nested lifecycle, retry, routing, authority or completion fields; preserve current prepareBillingWorkEvidence validation until reviewed replacement.
json_contracts.parameters: Exact frozen current checkout/customer/update request parameter contract, including presentation and approved price; digest covers canonical full parameters. Provider results, secret keys and client secrets prohibited.

ownership_provenance.rules: same scoped invoice/customer/subscription anchors; complete invoice lines; exact payment/allocation checks at charge commit; all price registry revisions active/current; zero guessed shared-customer authorization

json_contracts.operations.facts: Closed discriminated summary by operation_kind: subscription (task, before/after digest/revision, order decision); Finance (scoped affected row keys/revisions and proof anchors); checkout (attempt key/digest/result identity, never client secret); ownership (old/new revision/state); handover (old/new engine/generation/checkpoint); recovery (parent task/fixed reason); reconciliation (window/resource/page/count/coverage). Private RLS evidence, never log output.
json_contracts.operations.cursor: Run-only closed resource/endpoint/after/window cursor; NULL for immutable audit.
json_contracts.operations.coverage: Run-only discovered/admitted/resolved/attention counts plus resource/window/start/end, quality partial|complete. Complete only after all included tasks resolved or explicit attention.
